maintenanceAssessment: Adopt upstream Compose 1.12.1, the patch release in the already admitted 1.12 line, for the androidx.compose and org.jetbrains.compose coordinates bound to the catalog compose version. This clears lint NewerVersionAvailable without weakening warnings-as-errors. Upstream maintenance remains monitored by Dependabot and the security workflow; this records admission, not a claim of latest versions or no vulnerabilities. Android redistribution uses the reviewed licence closure and superseding resource profile r7; build and JVM preview dependencies remain non-distributed locked inputs.

closure-sbom.reason: Resolved closure keeps 195 components and 122 resource inputs; only Compose 1.12.0 -> 1.12.1 coordinates move, with sha256 verification metadata. Retained immutable coordinates are unchanged. CI regenerates the closure, SBOM and resource receipts from the committed locks.

compatibility.reason: Patch release; upstream module dependency metadata is identical apart from versions and file hashes. No framework major change. Local compilation, lint, JVM desktop and debug unit tests passed; Windows/Linux CI builds remain required.

compilation.reason: The documented local Windows build passed: spotlessCheck, desktop and debug unit tests, lintRelease with warnings as errors, instrumentation APK and release APK/AAB, plus a strictly locked rebuild of all four archives. Required Windows and Linux CI compilation and packaging remain the gate.

licence-provenance.reason: 74 moved components keep Apache-2.0, configurations, artifact sets, published-POM evidence and notices. The licence closure and provenance gates passed locally with resource profile r7; CI repeats the strict Gradle licence/resource gate and release archive verification.

local-runtime.reason: No Android device or emulator is part of the existing environment. JVM desktop and unit tests passed locally, but no installed-app runtime observation is claimed.

migration.reason: No persisted data, schema, protocol, app code or configuration changes; only library versions move within the patch line.

performance.reason: No performance measurement was taken for this patch upgrade; no app code or configuration changed.

security.reason: Upstream patch release inside the admitted Compose 1.12 line; no feed, publisher, public import or native payload change. The existing CodeQL/security workflow and Dependabot monitoring apply; no vulnerability-free claim is made.
